paper_id: Length Controlled Generation for Black-box LLMs__oa_W4412945110
title: Length Controlled Generation for Black-box LLMs
motivation: LLM难以精确控制生成长度，而微调方法计算开销大且无法用于黑盒模型
problem_framing: 将长度控制问题建模为从目标分布采样，采用MCMC迭代框架
key_insight: 用Metropolis-Hastings框架结合重要性采样加速，无需修改模型参数即可实现黑盒LLM的长度控制
method_signature: MH迭代采样 + 重要性采样加速的黑盒长度控制框架
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 原始MH方法比随机采样更差（40.2% vs 38.8%），需结合重要性采样才有效
evidence_for_taste: the proposal distribution plays a pivotal role
does not make the process more efficient and is sometimes even worse than random sampling
the sampling efficiency decreases as this discrepancy increases
not all LLMs are open source
enabling the integration of effective length control mechanisms across the broadest possible spectrum of LLMs
thinking_moves: 将长度控制问题从约束满足重新frame为概率采样问题
引入MCMC框架(Metropolis-Hastings)处理复杂分布
通过重要性采样改善proposal分布以提高采样效率
保持LLM作为黑盒不可变组件以兼容任意模型
用LLM-as-Judge估计自身概率分布以规避黑盒限制
